findings.summary: Root cause of round-1 high finding is in the transport, outside this unit: server/http/errorHandler.ts:77 spreads DomainError.details into the error object ({ error: { code, message, pendingBlocks } }) while src/api/httpClient.ts toApiError keeps only error.details. Fixed for the user path inside this unit: completeDiagnosis (src/api/diagnosesApi.ts) now catches a 422 'incomplete' without a block list, reads the stored draft (GET /api/diagnoses/:id) and runs the same shared pendingBlocks() the server uses (server/services/diagnosisService.ts:204), then rethrows an ApiError with details.pendingBlocks. If the transport is later aligned, the server list is used directly with no extra GET. Reproduced before the fix with a vitest probe (expected null not to be null), passing after.

Discard confirmation now uses the additive Diagnosis.createdAt sent by the backend (server/services/diagnosisService.ts:141) for 'Descartar o rascunho de {data}?', falling back to the last save time only if createdAt is absent. Diagnosis type gained optional createdAt and completedAt.

Runtime walkthrough not run (answer, reload #/diagnostico/:id, 'Salvo automaticamente às HH:MM', 'Ver meu resultado' with gaps, gate confirm/cancel, discard confirm/cancel). Needs the running backend plus a browser; a detached server is not allowed in this single session. tests/e2e/questionnaire.spec.ts and tests/e2e/calculator.spec.ts belong to integration.

evidence.result: before fix: exit 1, 1 failed | 2 passed (AC-dm-14 422 with error.pendingBlocks -> readPendingBlocks null); after fix: exit 0, 3 passed (server shape yields blocks; details.pendingBlocks read with a single fetch; 409 not read as pending)

messages.text: 422 incomplete transport mismatch: server/http/errorHandler.ts:77 sends pendingBlocks beside code/message, src/api/httpClient.ts toApiError only keeps error.details. The questionnaire now recovers by recomputing pendingBlocks from the stored draft (one extra GET), so AC-dm-14 works either way. Recommended alignment (owner phase-1-backend-diagnoses or phase-1-frontend-primitives): nest extra keys under error.details on the server, or have toApiError keep unknown error keys in details. Once aligned, diagnosesApi uses the server list with no extra GET.

Please move the regression probe into tests/unit (outside the frontend lane): mock fetch so POST /api/diagnoses/:id/complete returns 422 { error: { code: 'incomplete', message, pendingBlocks: [..] } } and GET returns a draft; assert readPendingBlocks(await completeDiagnosis(id).catch(e=>e)) is non-null (AC-dm-14). Then run e2e: tests/e2e/questionnaire.spec.ts and tests/e2e/calculator.spec.ts against the running app (answer, reload, 'Salvo automaticamente às HH:MM', pending alert links, gold gate confirm/cancel, discard confirm/cancel with the creation date).
